info.description:
Lazu API is a unified gateway for major AI models, fully OpenAI-compatible. Supports GPT, Claude, Gemini and other leading providers, plus Sora and Grok for video generation.

## Authentication
Every API request must carry an API key in the `Authorization` header:
```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```

## Base URL
- Primary: `https://api.lazu.ai`

tags.Models: Model listing, catalog, and capability-discovery endpoints.
tags.Files: OpenAI-compatible file upload, listing, download, and deletion APIs.
tags.Discovery: Model discovery, catalog inspection, and pricing metadata.
tags.Gemini: Gemini-native request format and discovery APIs.
tags.Account: Usage statistics, billing, and API key introspection.

get.summary: Get the public static model catalog.
get.description: Returns the same public list-price model discovery payload as unauthenticated `/v1/models`. This endpoint never accepts personalized API-key pricing fields and is intended for CDN caching, crawlers, and agent discovery.

Returns the model catalog reachable by the current API key. Best consulted before any production call so you can discover capabilities, supported endpoints, pricing, and example requests.

Results are auto-filtered to what the active API key can use, and additionally include:
- input / output modalities
- supported endpoint types
- directly callable endpoint paths
- pricing information
- parameter hints
- copy-paste curl examples

get.summary: Get public pricing and marketplace metadata.
get.description: Public pricing view for enabled models. Use `/api/models/catalog` when you need token-scoped discovery for a specific API key.

Returns the rich model discovery catalog in an OpenAI-compatible `{object:"list",data:[...]}` envelope. Authentication is optional: without a key the response includes every public enabled model with list pricing; with a key the same items also include `your_price`, `accessible`, and top-level `your_pricing_context`.

Use `include=health` to opt into best-effort runtime health fields. There is no `view` parameter; the default response is already rich.
Returns the same rich catalog item shape as `/v1/models` for one model ID.
Lists files uploaded by the current API key owner. Use `purpose` to filter by supported file purpose.

post.description:
Uploads a file for later retrieval or for `file_id` references in `/v1/responses` input items.

Self-hosted deployments must configure `artifact_storage` with Cloudflare R2 or another S3-compatible bucket. Tencent COS exposes a partially compatible S3 endpoint, but Lazu has not verified it. Without object storage, this endpoint returns `503 storage_not_configured`.

Supported purposes:
- `user_data`: non-executable files up to 512 MiB
- `vision`: PNG, JPEG, GIF, or WebP images up to 20 MiB

get.description: Returns metadata for a file owned by the current API key owner.

delete.description: Deletes a file and its object-storage content. Remaining TTL storage charges are refunded according to the backend accounting rules.

get.description: Downloads the raw file bytes for a file owned by the current API key owner.

post.description: Generate a model response from the supplied message list. Supports streaming output and multi-turn conversations.

post.summary: Create a message using Anthropic-native format.
post.description:
Use this endpoint when the selected model includes `anthropic` in `supported_endpoint_types`.

Authentication supports either:
- `Authorization: Bearer <api-key>`
- `x-api-key: <api-key>`

Use this endpoint when the selected model includes `gemini` in `supported_endpoint_types`.

Authentication supports:
- `Authorization: Bearer <api-key>`
- `x-goog-api-key: <api-key>`
- `?key=<api-key>`
